read.title: Shipment Notice – Order No. 2481
read.text:
Dear Mr. Silva,

I'm writing to let you know that your order of 6,000 sheet masks left Busan this morning. The goods were loaded into one 20-foot container, and the vessel's ETA at the port of Santos is December 9.

Please find attached the commercial invoice, packing list, and a copy of the bill of lading. The original documents will be sent by courier after we receive the balance payment.

Please let us know if your customs broker needs any other documents.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.en: Write a short email telling a buyer that their order has shipped, when it should arrive, and which documents you attached.
hints: I'm writing to let you know that
write.model:
Dear Ms. Wong,

I'm writing to let you know that your order of 3,000 toner pads was shipped from Busan today. The ETA at the port of Singapore is November 24. Please find attached the packing list and a copy of the bill of lading. Please let us know if you need any other documents for customs clearance.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
